verdict.rationale: Auto-shutdown timers and spend limits are a fair axis for a GPU cloud, but the docs show neither. Only adjacent features are documented: the Usage page for viewing spend, per-minute billing, and cloud-init and API building blocks a user could script around. Community evidence points to absence: a user who forgot an instance ran up a $583 bill, support said Lambda doesn't distinguish idle from in-use instances, and the user's suggestion of auto-stop or limits went unanswered.
